First, subtract 8 months from 1273-03-12:  
8 months before March is July of the previous year (since 8 months back from March is July 1272).  
1272 is a leap year (divisible by 4 in the Gregorian calendar rules given).

1273-03-12 → 1272-07-12 after subtracting 8 months.

Now subtract 13 days from 1272-07-12:  
July 12 minus 13 days = June 29, 1272 (June has 30 days).

FINAL_ANSWER: 1272-06-29
